# freecropimage.app

## Summary
freecropimage.app is a free, browser-based image cropper. Crop, rotate, flip, and resize images with preset aspect ratios for social media. No login. No upload. All processing local.

## Key Facts
- Price: Free (Pro batch cropping at $2.88/month with cloud sync)
- Login required: No
- Privacy: All processing client-side via Canvas API, zero server uploads
- Formats: JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG input. JPG, PNG, WebP output with quality control.
- Features: Free crop, aspect ratio lock, 10+ social presets (Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn), rotate 90°, flip H/V, zoom, rule-of-thirds grid, output format/quality selection, undo (Ctrl+Z), keyboard shortcuts
- Technology: Pure Canvas API, vanilla JavaScript, zero dependencies, zero tracking
- Offline: Works after first visit via service worker
- Mobile: Fully responsive with touch-friendly crop handles

## Comparison
- vs Canva: freecropimage.app is instant with no account (Canva requires login)
- vs iLovePDF Image Crop: freecropimage.app never uploads images
- vs Photopea: freecropimage.app is simpler and faster for cropping specifically
